title: phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticifolium
intro: Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticifolium, commonly known as a type of bellflower, is a plant species within the Campanulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticifolium contribute to its potential use in the treatment of various health conditions, and further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
